about_short_description.short_description: Take Take Take is an application that provides chess practice for people.

product.name: Take Take Take Chess App
product.description: A chess practice and social platform for playing games, reviewing performance with AI-generated feedback, tracking progress, and sharing results with other players. Available on iOS, Android, and the web.

product.name: Chess Openings
product.description: A web-based chess opening reference and exploration tool covering named openings, variations, and player-specific recommendations based on rating, time format, playing style, and game history.
